name: Internal inventory and rental asset tracker

mentions.name: Internal inventory and rental asset tracker
mentions.description: An internal tool the author vibed together that handles inventory tracking and rental asset management well enough for their team, though it is closer to a prettier, semi-automated version of their existing spreadsheets than a true CRM.
mentions.problem: The space between a full-blown ERP and a spreadsheet tracker is abysmal, with middle managers juggling fleet, field crew, procurement, account management and AR/AP by swapping between 12 different trackers per hour just to find a snippet of information.
mentions.source_excerpt: I have something vibed together as an internal tool that does well enough, but definitely not something I would ever refer to as a CRM by any stretch of the imagination and the bridge between basic on-the-shelf inventory and tracking rental assets are two completely different beasts.
mentions.author: tropicalhunter
